accepted_state_temperature_observations.basis: sample extrema from retained accepted solver traces; display sampling is not continuous-time certification

assumptions.electricity: Upstream drying and downstream compression are outside this boundary.
assumptions.engine: Versioned extension of retained V21 transverse symmetric half-bed parallel-channel model with local gas, solid, wall and heater states and generalized site storage.
assumptions.hardware: KNF N922 50 Hz reference curve, 135 W running input, 2 kW heater, one combined 2 kW cooling budget at COP 3, and an ideal pump-inlet knockout targeting 55 C.
assumptions.humidity: Humidity is gas forcing; the selected material adapter owns the water equilibrium law.
assumptions.pressure_control: Reviewed V21 throttle controller uses the maximum local cell pressure and the common regeneration target.
assumptions.transport: Axial breakthrough and manifold redistribution are not resolved.

representation_difference.lumped: phase requests act on one well-mixed bed temperature
representation_difference.pressure_control: spatial retains its local-pressure valve control; lumped retains the reviewed target-inlet pressure control
representation_difference.spatial: phase requests act through finite wall/heater transfer and local through-thickness states

operating_policy.source: Reviewed portable lumped phase requests, mapped to spatial wall and heater nodes with finite transfer.

checks.temperature_limit_basis: recorded scenario excursion; no evidenced physical limit

unassessed_limits: Pump, conditioner, material-law and hardware qualification not recorded by this result remain unestablished.
The declared temperature scalar is an unqualified scenario guard; no evidenced physical degradation limit is recorded.

numerical_reliability.statement: A separate identical-input mesh and tighter-solver study is required; this is a screening diagnostic.

target_attainment.statement: Requested regeneration, vacuum and cooling endpoints are advisory operating outcomes. A miss does not by itself reject or rank down a screening case. Completed-stage attainment uses the latest completed cycle; partial tails are reported separately and are not counted as completed-target misses.

policy.basis: Opt-in bounded BDF internal trial recovery: a finite, near-zero negative water trial with an otherwise dry accepted state may restore exact accepted history and retry with a smaller internal step. Raw equations, accepted states, inventories, rates and conservation remain unchanged.
policy.evidence_gap: No evidenced physical degradation limit is recorded.

temperature_guard.statement: Scenario guard outcomes are execution/evidence classifications. An excursion with no evidenced physical degradation limit is not a physical hard-limit pass.

endpoint.legacy_interpretation: Achieved endpoint fields use the latest completed cycle. Any partial final-stage samples remain present in cycles, traces and the finite-horizon record and are reported separately from completed targets.

caloric_closure.basis: native constant CP_GAS with 70/46 kJ/mol process heats

last_rate_details.classification: temperature-advisory conditional extrapolation; accepted state follows the configured equation path

material_query_temperature_observations.basis: all successful and attempted material calls, including accepted ODE states and solver/Jacobian trial queries; not the accepted-state peak

adapter.relative_humidity_use: continuous conditional interpolation within RH 0-0.55; 30% and 55% are source conditions, not independent validation
adapter.temperature_policy: record accepted and query temperatures; reject only genuine constitutive or equation-domain failures

assumptions: Measured Young coupled support remains 25-70 C and RH 0-0.55.
Temperatures outside measured support are exploratory extrapolation, including local transient excursions.
The requested 116 C regeneration target and the previous 20-120 C evaluation range are advisory and are not hard stops.
No temperature ceiling or state-temperature clamp is introduced; actual temperatures remain in accepted states, histories and exports.
The local water branch uses H2O partial pressure divided by IAPWS saturation pressure and requires an unsaturated finite branch.

Opt-in raw-component eligibility is the scale-aware -5e-9 mol/kg continuation band (5 times the actual 1e-9 mol/kg component atol): finite values between -1e-9 and -5e-9 warn and continue, while values below -5e-9 or nonfinite inputs remain hard failures.

After the opt-in eligibility decision, the lower constitutive helper's older 1e-9 mol/kg negative guard applies only to its already nonnegative evaluation input; that helper threshold does not define the raw-state eligibility band.

The actual evolving stored-water inventory drives the unchanged Young WADST CO2 target. A constitutive evaluation copy may be floored, but every raw state, inventory, rate delta, energy quantity and export remains unchanged.
Hot binary coupling, adsorption/desorption rates and energy transfer are unvalidated transfers.
Wilkins 110 C and Low 2023 measurements are diagnostic constraints, not fitted corrections or same-specimen validation.

Only the separately identified BDF recovery package may convert a finite near-zero water trial rejection into a bounded internal step retry; it does not alter accepted states or widen material eligibility.

evidence.basis: The unchanged Young 2021 Toth, GAB, LDF-rate and process-heat values are evaluated with IAPWS local saturation in a named exploratory scenario. Actual temperatures are recorded; the requested 116 C value and former 20-120 C range are not hard validity boundaries. Genuine equation-domain branches remain enforced. This package adds an opt-in dry numerical continuation policy; the accepted advisory package remains unchanged. This separately identified package adds bounded internal BDF trial recovery; original strict and five-atol packages remain unchanged.
evidence.not_for: validated equilibrium or coupling outside 25-70 C, measured humid-cycle accuracy, validated hot-vacuum rates or energy transfer, equipment suitability, cyclic steady state, lifetime, degradation trigger, or annual production.

target_attainment.statement: Requested regeneration, vacuum and cooling endpoints are advisory operating outcomes. A miss does not by itself reject or rank down a screening case. Completed-stage attainment uses the latest completed cycle; partial tails are reported separately and are not counted as completed-target misses.

policy.basis: Opt-in bounded BDF internal trial recovery: a finite, near-zero negative water trial with an otherwise dry accepted state may restore exact accepted history and retry with a smaller internal step. Raw equations, accepted states, inventories, rates and conservation remain unchanged.
policy.evidence_gap: No evidenced physical degradation limit is recorded.

temperature_guard.statement: Scenario guard outcomes are execution/evidence classifications. An excursion with no evidenced physical degradation limit is not a physical hard-limit pass.
